summary_markdown:
A discussion occurred regarding the interpretation of location data limitations provided by a client. [p1] noted that the last column in an analyzed file appeared to be a radius limitation for every location, but questioned if it represented distance only to the road or included general areas.

[p3] confirmed that during a call with [p1], they clarified the requirements: For 40-50m ranges, traffic limitation should not be applied, as this matches previous standards (e.g., Denmark).

Furthermore, for Mall locations specifically, the client requested a 10m radius limit, which is believed to capture only people passing the screens rather than dwelling within the shops. This manual counting approach needs verification.
decisions: For 40-50m ranges, traffic limitation will not be applied.
Mall location limitations are set at 10m and require manual confirmation.
action_items: Check Mall location limits with manual counting to confirm the 10m radius requirement.
